name: ActivityPub Scheduler
description: Integrates ActivityPub with the Scheduler module so federated posts are sent when a node is scheduled to publish and withdrawn when unpublished.
project_description: Submodule of the ActivityPub project that integrates with the Scheduler module. It subscribes to Scheduler's node publish/unpublish events: on scheduled publish it (re)queues the node's outbox ActivityPub activities for delivery to followers, and on scheduled unpublish it unpublishes them. Ships a scheduler ActivityPub type config entity.
